column1: # Unicode UTS#39 confusables.txt 17.0.0 — digit-policy overrides (#561). Rows where disarm folds a digit to the ASCII DIGIT and TR39 folds it to something else — mostly a Latin letter, but also punctuation ('.') and one two-character sequence ('rn'). The value is TR39's target run through ASCII_FOLD, so it is always ASCII (#341/#587); a divergence with no ASCII form is dropped and tr39 falls back to the numeric reading. Applied only under digit_policy='tr39'. Generated by scripts/gen_confusables.py.
